title: Map Telegram planner budgets and progress counters

findings.summary: Live MAX_PAGE clamp plus walk short-page exhaustion will drop remaining history if BATCH_LIMIT ever exceeds MAX_PAGE.
evidence: packages/connector-telegram/src/walk.ts:290-304 want = BATCH_LIMIT - events.length; seen < want sets exhausted
packages/connector-telegram/src/scripted.ts:125 scripted API does not clamp, so in-tree tests would miss a BATCH_LIMIT increase
findings.current_production: BATCH_LIMIT === MAX_PAGE === 500, so the clamp is a no-op today
findings.scaled_proof: small-page-fixture.ts case S7 (PAGE=3, BATCH=5) marks exhausted at last_id=3; S7b (PAGE=5) fills the batch instead

findings.summary: Durable progress is the cursor only. batch.read, seen, want, and PurgeIndex are process-local.
evidence: packages/connector-telegram/src/walk.ts:297,236 read is returned on WalkResult, not encoded
packages/connector-telegram/src/plan.ts:11-36 PurgeIndex in-memory; connector.ts:278-283 purgeSource reports those ids as unreachable
